name: Trang An Landscape Complex
description: Near the southern edge of the Red River Delta in Ninh Binh Province, Trang An is a maze of limestone peaks, steep cliffs and flooded valleys that visitors explore by rowing boat, gliding through low caves. Cave finds show people lived here for over 30,000 years, and Hoa Lu, Viet Nam's 10th-century capital, stood among these hills. Temples, pagodas and paddy fields fill the gaps between the karst.
